subject: Request: Early offboarding carveout & ramp opt-out — Helix Therapeutics
messages:
From: Caroline Ross <caroline.ross@helixtx.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: ramp schedule & early termination carveout

Sergio —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Quick situation update from our side: the FDA submission timeline for our flagship product has slipped ~5 months and the PO we expected to ramp in Q3 will likely only be meaningful in Q1 next year. We still want to move forward with Redwood (capacity + security were big wins in our eval) but need two contract accommodations to proceed:

1) A temporary ramp opt-out so we aren't charged full ramp-based commit while our clinical timelines are delayed.
2) An early offboarding grace that allows us to terminate within the first 90 days with a reduced penalty (ideally a credit rather than cash tail) if the external regulatory delay prevents onboarding.

We can accept a modest concession on price if necessary — this is very much about timing, not product fit. I've attached our proposed SOW for context. Can your procurement/sales team advise what flexibility exists?

Appreciate any expedited guidance — procurement is running a parallel review and will need a proposal for legal.

— Caroline
Head of Procurement
Helix Therapeutics
Attachment: Helix_SOW_v1.pdf

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: ramp schedule & early termination carveout

Team — forwarding Helix request. Key asks: ramp opt-out and a 90-day early offboarding grace convertible to credit. Context: Helix is a strategic target (clinical data use case), potential $600k ARR in 12–18 months if FDA timelines normalize.

Proposed commercial approach (suggested by me):
- Offer a time-limited ramp suspension for first 120 days (no ramp consumption billed) instead of the standard immediate commit, coupled with a 20% discount on list for first 6 months once active.
- If Helix cannot begin meaningful usage within 90 days of contract effective date due to regulatory delay, allow termination with an early offboarding credit equal to unused committed value capped at $75k. Credit applied as customer account balance or invoice credit — prefer credit (finance).

Legal needs to vet a short addendum that:
- Defines triggering event (regulatory delay preventing onboarding),
- States credit calculation and cap ($75k),
- Clarifies that standard SLA/indemnities remain in force,
- Excludes data retention fees beyond 30 days after termination.

Attachments: Redwood_Ramp_Addendum_v1.docx (draft redline)

Request: can deal desk + legal greenlight the commercial terms above? If yes, I will take back to Caroline with DocuSign ready.

Thanks — Sergio
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-28T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: ramp schedule & early termination carveout

Sergio —

Appreciate the writeup. Quick thoughts: Helix is strategically valuable but the earnback mechanics need to protect us. Two asks from deal desk:

1) Please add a graduated clawback: if customer terminates after 45–90 days, credit cap reduces pro rata to $50k at 45 days, $25k at 30 days (protects short-lived trial churn).
2) Confirm we can limit the ramp suspension to usage-related charges only (no discount on platform/observability addons).

I can approve up to $50k credit administratively. Anything above that requires Vivek signoff (cc'd). Also need finance to confirm credit mechanics (account balance vs cash refund).

Can you get Helix to accept the clawback ladder and confirm which SKUs they want excluded from suspension? If they sign, I'm fine moving to exec for a final waiver.

— Marissa
Director, Deal Desk

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-29T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: ramp schedule & early termination carveout

Sergio / Marissa —

Attached is a short redline. Key legal items to include in the addendum:

- Trigger definition: "Regulatory Delay" means (i) a governmental or regulatory action outside of Helix's control that materially prevents Helix from deploying the Solution for production use as defined in SOW, or (ii) persistent failure to obtain regulatory clearance required for the Solution to process production data.
- Credit mechanics: credit limited to unused committed fees, applied as account credit, non-transferable, expires 12 months from issuance.
- Data: Redwood retains data for up to 30 days after termination; longer retention requires separate MSA Appendix and fees.
- No change to indemnity or data protection obligations; Redwood requests narrow language to avoid unlimited exposure.

If commercial agrees to the $75k cap with pro-rata ladder proposed by Marissa, legal can finalize the addendum for signature. Attachment: Redwood_Ramp_Addendum_v1.docx

- Karthik
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Escalation: Helix offboarding grace — request for executive approval

Vivek —

Summary for exec decision (fast): Helix Therapeutics (target account) has regulatory delay pushing production ramp ~5 months. They will sign if we can: (A) suspend ramp billing for first 120 days, (B) provide early termination credit with a $75k cap on unused commit, applied as account credit, with a pro-rata reduction ladder (Marissa recommended $50k @45d / $25k @30d). Legal approves the trigger language and credit mechanics (see attached redline).

Financials/backstop: estimated revenue deferral vs risk — if they terminate and take full credit, max exposure $75k; upside if they ramp later is likely $600k ARR over 12–18 months. Deal desk supports up to $50k; I am requesting executive exception to approve up to $75k and sign the addendum so we can get DocuSign to Helix today. HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7654321. DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/Helix/Envelope/ACX-987654

Ask: please reply with APPROVE or DENY. If APPROVE, legal will finalize and I will send DocuSign to the customer.

Thanks for the quick read — Sergio
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
